# Zeriotic

> Zeriotic is an independent premium web development studio. It builds
> high-performance web applications, e-commerce platforms and SaaS products,
> including real-time 3D and WebGL product experiences, for a handful of
> clients each year. Founded 2022. Independent team of sixteen. Headquartered
> in Dhaka, Bangladesh, serving clients worldwide.

Zeriotic is not a freelancer marketplace and not a template or
website-builder company. It is a senior product engineering and design
studio: every engagement is designed and built in-house by the studio's own
senior engineers and designers. It works with founders, product teams and
companies of any size, in any region. A business with no website today and a
business replatforming a marketplace are both normal cases.

## The distinction that matters

Most agencies sell decks and hand implementation to juniors or
subcontractors. Zeriotic designs and ships: senior people do the actual
work, there are no account managers, the client clicks through a staging
environment from day one, and ownership-grade documentation is handed over
so the product outlives the engagement.

## Key facts

- Company: Zeriotic, independent premium web development studio, founded 2022
- Co-founders: Al Mueid Hoque and Mahdi Hasan, both titled Co-founder
- Team: 16 senior engineers and designers; no account managers, no subcontracting
- Headquarters: Dhaka, Bangladesh (23.81N / 90.41E)
- Clients: founders and product teams worldwide; delivered work spans the United States, Europe, Japan and South Asia
- Availability: accepts a handful of engagements per quarter; responds within 24 hours
- Services: full-stack web applications; e-commerce platforms (headless, custom checkout, ERP); SaaS products (auth, billing, public API, multi-tenant); AI integration (RAG, embeddings, agent pipelines); interactive 3D and WebGL product experiences
- Stack: Next.js, Remix, Astro, Vite, Node.js, Bun, Postgres, Redis, Vercel, Cloudflare, AWS, Stripe, Clerk, Three.js, GSAP
- Process: four phases; discover and define (1-2 weeks), design the system (2-4 weeks), engineer and ship (4-10 weeks), iterate in the open (ongoing)
- Record: 47 products shipped, 98% client retention, median TTFB 12ms, 4.9/5 client rating

## Pricing

Zeriotic does not publish fixed prices. Projects are scoped during discovery
and agreed as a fixed engagement. The budget bands used for intake are
$10,000 to $25,000, $25,000 to $50,000, $50,000 to $100,000 and $100,000+.
Email hello@zeriotic.com for a quote; response time is within 24 hours.
